coaching.headline: A 30-11 five-stack win built on the 19.2 Fangtooth wipe (5-0) and a clean late game — Primal and Orb both banked at 32-33.
coaching.team: We took every major from 13 minutes on: Mini Prime 13, Fangtooth 20 and 25, Genesis 23, Primal 32, Orb 33. The mid-game fights did it — 5-0 at our Fangtooth at 19.2, then 2-0s at 22.1 and 24.5, and the 4-0 at Primal at 32. What a better team punishes: the 8.2 bad trade (0-2 deep in our half with three of us absent) and giving their Fangtooth at 12 on a cross-map trade. Five of five won fights should cash; three did.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 19.2-minute 5-0 wipe at our Fangtooth broke the game open, and the 32-minute 4-0 at Primal banked Primal plus Orb in one window.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock went 10/1/3 in the offlane with 20k objective damage — the game's engine. The one blemish is instructive: the single death, caught alone by Wukong at 29.8, still cost the inner tower at 30.7. Even at 10-and-0, a solo death buys the enemy a building.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Gideon finished 6/0/7 — a deathless mid. The lane read slid late (theirs by the last checkpoints) but it never showed on the scoreboard. At the 8.2 bad trade the macro shows mid ahead and un-rotated; with the rest of the game this clean, that early shove-and-rotate is the last habit to add.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari owned the jungle all game — 8/2 with 32k objective damage, the most on the team. That objective damage is exactly what converted the fight wins into the 13-to-33-minute major streak. Vision was 4 wards this time; keep building it.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mourn's 22 wards carried the map's vision, and 0/4/11 is the support line the team needed. Two of the four deaths were the 8.2 bad trade deep in our half and the 10.9 death that preceded their Fangtooth — both fights the team chose badly, worth vetoing from the support seat.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eden put up 5/4 with 15.5k objective damage. The early game was the rough patch — caught at 4.1 by Wukong and part of the 8.2 bad trade. The build sat off the Solaris and Nuclear Rounds pieces of the meta core; on-core, the mid-game fights get cheaper.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Maco. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage

murdock.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Justice's Reach, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 91% of Murdock offlane players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Long Arm of the Law at rank 3: 95s base, about 79.2s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Nuclear Rounds 20.
Murdock dealt 37,418 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Terra (level 17: about 280 physical armor, 268 after penetration; took 26,355 physical damage from heroes, 78% of all hero damage they took) and Wukong (level 18: about 155 physical armor, 143 after penetration; took 14,658 physical damage from heroes, 49% of all hero damage they took) that is about 3% and 5% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 4,528 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 3 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Terra, Wukong). Anti-heal on Skylar, Terra. We killed Murdock 1 time.
Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 43.5% in 214 Murdock offlane games, below the hero's 49.6%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

gideon.loadout: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery), augment Infinite Impact, crest Epoch
fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
ultPlus: Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Gideon mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gideon touched shortened Black Hole, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 52.8s late); fight right after Black Hole is spent.
Black Hole at rank 3: 105s base, about 52.8s by the end (50% shorter) from 99 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Soulbinder 20, Timewarp 25, Tainted Scepter 10, Epoch 8, Tithe of Death (minor) 26.
Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 13 takedowns.
13 takedowns (6 kills, 7 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice), Tithe of Death (minor).
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Gideon dealt 37,004 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +530 magical power from items.

Penetration: Caustica ignores 35%; against Wukong (level 18: about 60 magical armor, 39 after penetration; took 12,515 magical damage from heroes, 42% of all hero damage they took) and Howitzer (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 32 after penetration; took 16,040 magical damage from heroes, 66% of all hero damage they took) that is about 15% and 13% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Soulbinder (item): Damage Heroes from afar with Abilities: Deal 8% bonus Damage. Activates at 1450+ Range.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 20.6% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; 2,565 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 19,793 damage, mitigated 14,118, died 0 times.
Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Wukong took about 15% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 60, about 39 after 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Caustica, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 99 ability haste brought them back 50% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Tithe of Death. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Gideon killed built magical armor. We killed Gideon 0 times.
Copy it? Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery): 48.7% in 2,298 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.8%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Gideon's takedowns fed Black Hole: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Black Hole is used.

members.text: Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.

members.name: Tithe of Death
members.text: Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Tithe of Death. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 0 of the 4 players Gideon killed built magical armor.

copy.text: Vesh (Tithe of Death + Phylactery): 48.7% in 2,298 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.8%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

lead.text: Never died in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Gideon mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
